items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Oh, we were into some of the early things, in other words, Horace Silver.

ctx.x: Pete. Peaked. You had Nat writing for you once again, there. It was quite a bit of material, it seemed to me.

And he was taking things which ordinarily -- put into the concept, maybe they wouldn't have been done by as many people, if we hadn't first gotten into it. Oh, we were into some of the early things, in other words, Horace Silver.
